# TeaVM javac

Official artifacts from the TeaVM playground at https://teavm.org/playground/,
retrieved on 2026-11-21. Source and build instructions:
https://github.com/konsoletyper/teavm-javac

TeaVM javac is distributed under Apache 2.0. The compiler uses OpenJDK
components under GPL version 2 with the Classpath Exception. Sources:
https://github.com/konsoletyper/teavm and https://github.com/openjdk/jdk.
License copies are in `public/licenses`. VCode uses these artifacts unmodified.
